ProgramUnit.Name: INITIALISE_WINDOWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 lv_ver_no VARCHAR2(3);
BEGIN
--/***
 -- [Ver : 02 ] 
 -- [Ver : 03 ] -- IM 8497
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 
 --lv_ver_no := '01'; -- LT2018
 lv_ver_no := '02'; -- MLT 895
 
 set_window_property('win_donation',title,' DEWDONBR [Ver : ' || lv_ver_no || ' ] '||
 'User List Browser Window'); 

 IF :PARAMETER.P_list_id is not null THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.list_id := :parameter.p_list_id;

 ELSE

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RETRIEVE_DATA IS
BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.list_id is null 
 THEN 
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.LIST_ID');
 show_error('18159');
 END IF;
 :GLOBAL.BLK2_flag := 'N' ;

 item_change('user_menu.CALLED_USER','E');

 go_block('user_menu');
 :system.message_level := 10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 go_record(1);
 IF :system.cursor_value is null THEN
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.LIST_ID');
 show_error('11091');
 ELSE
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.LIST_ID','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve','D');
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_LIST_lov',enabled,property_false);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CTRL_BLK_2_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ctrl_blk_2_date IS
cursor c1 is
select distinct trunc(call_date) from donor_lists where 
called_user = :user_menu.called_user
and list_id = :ctrl_blk_1.list_id
union
select distinct trunc(sched_date) from donor_lists where 
sched_user = :user_menu.called_user
and list_id = :ctrl_blk_1.list_id;
BEGIN
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 first_record;
 open c1;
 loop
 fetch c1 into :ctrl_blk_2.call_date;
 exit when C1%NOTFOUND ;
 :ctrl_blk_2.call_day := :ctrl_blk_2.call_date ;
 ctrl_blk_2_values;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 first_record;
 :GLOBAL.BLK2_flag := 'Y';
 go_block('user_menu');
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_LIST_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT A.LIST_ID, A.LIST_NAME, A.INSERT_DATE FROM DONOR_LIST_HEADER A, DONOR_LISTS B
WHERE A.LIST_ID=B.LIST_ID
and a.list_type = 'CALL'
and a.chapter_id = b.chapter_id
and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
ORDER BY A.INSERT_DATE desc

Trigger.Name: ON-MESSAGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 alert_button NUMBER; 
 lv_errtyp VARCHAR2(3) := MESSAGE_TYPE;
 lv_errcod NUMBER := MESSAGE_CODE;
 lv_errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := MESSAGE_TEXT;
BEGIN 
 IF lv_errcod = 41800 THEN 
 show_error('1180');
 
 ELSE 
 IF lv_errcod = 40350 THEN 
 show_error('18187');
 ELSE 
 Message(lv_errtyp||'-'||to_char(lv_errcod)||': '||lv_errtxt);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
END;
